_comment: Template for computecoin_agent.windows.runtime.provision --settings. Copy, edit, never commit real keys. Keys starting with underscore are ignored.
_manifest_public_key_help: PINNED Ed25519 public key (32 bytes, base64 or 64 hex characters) of the release signing key. Empty = every manifest is refused. This is a PUBLIC key; never put a private key here.
_limits_help: memory_mb and cpus cap ALL job containers together (systemd slice inside the distro). disk_gb caps the distro's virtual disk. vm_memory_mb and vm_processors are used only with wslconfig_policy add_missing.
_wslconfig_policy_help: never = never touch the owner's %UserProfile%\.wslconfig (default). add_missing = add only keys the owner has not set, marked, with a backup.
